{"individuals": [
{"title": "Edit Check", "class": "product.softwarecapability", "quote": "Offer people actionable feedback about Wikipedia policies while they are editing."},
{"title": "Editing Team", "class": "business.businessactor", "quote": "The Editing Team is working on a set of improvements for the visual editor to help new volunteers understand and follow some of the policies and guidelines"},
{"title": "Wikimedia Foundation's Product Department", "class": "business.businessactor", "quote": "why the Wikimedia Foundation's Product Department is prioritizing this work"},
{"title": "Reference check", "class": "product.feature", "quote": "**Reference check**"},
{"title": "Link check and Reference reliability", "class": "product.feature", "quote": "**Link check and Reference reliability**"},
{"title": "Paste Check", "class": "product.feature", "quote": "**Paste Check**"},
{"title": "Tone check", "class": "product.feature", "quote": "**Tone check**"},
{"title": "Suggestion Mode", "class": "product.feature", "quote": "The feature has been available as a Beta Feature globally since early March and at English Wikipedia since early February."},
{"title": "TextMatch", "class": "product.feature", "quote": "Some communities have started to use the textMatch feature to create custom local types of Suggestion."},
{"title": "Add an image suggestion type", "class": "product.feature", "quote": "A new experimental suggestion type, \"Add an image\", has been created using the same functionality as the Growth team's version."},
{"title": "Add a link suggestion type", "class": "product.feature", "quote": "improving the functionality of the \"Add a link\" suggestion type, so that it can become a default global suggestion type in the future"},
{"title": "addReference suggestions", "class": "product.feature", "quote": "Better detection of existing references for the `addReference` suggestions"},
{"title": "ignoreQuotedContent setting", "class": "product.feature", "quote": "Better detection of quotations for the `ignoreQuotedContent` setting"},
{"title": "Toggle-button to hide suggestions", "class": "ux.actioncomponent", "quote": "Addition of a toggle-button to hide suggestions temporarily - this will soon also save the 'hidden' state across future edit-sessions"},
{"title": "Special:EditChecks", "class": "ux.view", "quote": "Clearer and more accurate details in `Special:EditChecks` which shows the local configuration"},
{"title": "Multi-Check", "class": "product.feature", "quote": "Multi-Check was deployed to all wikis where Reference Check is currently available on June 25, 2025."},
{"title": "Desktop siderail", "class": "ux.subview", "quote": "This change shifted Edit Checks from appearing *within* articles to appearing *alongside* them, in a new \"siderail.\""},
{"title": "Mobile publishing workflow Edit Check step", "class": "product.workflowstep", "quote": "The first version of Edit Check will introduce a new step within the *mobile* visual editor's publishing workflow that people will see if/when they add new content *without* a reference."},
{"title": "editcheck/init.js", "class": "technology.artifact", "quote": "The conditions above are implemented and maintained in code here: editcheck/init.js"},
{"title": "Project start", "class": "product.milestone", "quote": "Start: | 2022-10-01"},
{"title": "Siderail design release December 2024", "class": "product.milestone", "quote": "In December 2024, we released a new design for the Edit Check desktop experience."},
{"title": "Multi-Check deployment June 25, 2025", "class": "product.milestone", "quote": "Multi-Check was deployed to all wikis where Reference Check is currently available on June 25, 2025."},
{"title": "Newcomers from Sub-Saharan Africa feel safe publishing useful changes", "class": "motivation.goal", "quote": "Newcomers and Junior Contributors from Sub-Saharan Africa will feel safe and confident enough while editing to publish changes they are proud of and that experienced volunteers consider useful."},
{"title": "Moderators notice quality improvement and configure Edit Check", "class": "motivation.goal", "quote": "Moderators at the English and French Wikipedias will notice improvements in the quality of edits newcomers are making and be motivated to configure how Edit Check presents policies to them."},
{"title": "Newcomers and Junior Contributors from Sub-Saharan Africa", "class": "motivation.stakeholder", "quote": "Newcomers and Junior Contributors from Sub-Saharan Africa will feel safe and confident enough while editing"},
{"title": "Moderators at English and French Wikipedias", "class": "motivation.stakeholder", "quote": "Moderators at the English and French Wikipedias will notice improvements in the quality of edits newcomers are making"},
{"title": "Experienced volunteers/moderators", "class": "motivation.stakeholder", "quote": "**Experienced volunteers/moderators** – need to do more work reverting low-quality edits and posting messages on inexperienced volunteers' talk pages"},
{"title": "Inexperienced volunteers", "class": "motivation.stakeholder", "quote": "**Inexperienced volunteers** – become disappointed and frustrated when the good-faith change(s) they arrived to the wiki seeking to make are undone"},
{"title": "People learning the basics of contributing", "class": "product.persona", "quote": "we are considering people who are still \"learning the basics\" to be people who have published <100 cumulative edits to a single, or multiple, Wikipedias"},
{"title": "Store suggestions more efficiently for reuse", "class": "motivation.goal", "quote": "The team is building a way for Suggestions to be stored more efficiently, so that in the future the suggestions can be used by, or shown within, other software features"},
{"title": "LLMs effective at corroborating sources in English", "class": "motivation.assessment", "quote": "This research confirmed that in English LLMs are effective at evaluating whether web-based sources corroborate claims on Wikipedia."},
{"title": "Measure Suggestion Mode impact via A/B experiment", "class": "motivation.goal", "quote": "to measure what kind of impact the tool has on the percentage of constructive (un-reverted) edits by newcomers, as well as editor-retention and any changes in revert-rates and block rates"},
{"title": "Detect new content added without reference", "class": "motivation.requirement", "quote": "The first \"check\" the Editing Team will be introducing is one that will detect when people are attempting to add *new* content to an existing article *without* a corresponding reference and prompt them to do so."},
{"title": "Visual editor teaches technical skills successfully", "class": "motivation.assessment", "quote": "the editing experience has been reasonably successful at helping inexperienced volunteers learn the *technical skills* necessary to publish changes to Wikipedia"},
{"title": "Editing interfaces don't surface policies", "class": "motivation.assessment", "quote": "The trouble is that the visual editor and other editing interfaces do not make people aware of the Wikipedia policies and guidelines they are expected to follow."},
{"title": "Reverted newcomers become demotivated and leave", "class": "motivation.assessment", "quote": "These poor interactions are demotivating and drive these could-be volunteers and community members, and the knowledge that are uniquely positioned to offer, away."},
{"title": "Experienced volunteers burdened educating newcomers", "class": "motivation.assessment", "quote": "Continually needing to educate inexperienced volunteers and undo their changes can lead to experienced volunteers becoming skeptical of inexperienced volunteers and impatient with them."},
{"title": "Wikipedia projects struggle to grow and diversify", "class": "motivation.assessment", "quote": "**Wikipedia projects** – struggle to grow and diversify their volunteer populations and shrink the knowledge gaps present within Wikimedia wikis."},
{"title": "Offer actionable policy feedback during editing", "class": "motivation.goal", "quote": "Offering inexperienced volunteers relevant and actionable feedback about Wikipedia policies in the precious moments when they are in the midst of making a change using the visual editor."},
{"title": "Let moderators specify feedback shown to newcomers", "class": "motivation.goal", "quote": "Equipping moderators with a new ability to specify the feedback inexperienced volunteers are presented with while they are editing"},
{"title": "Make norms legible and actionable while editing", "class": "motivation.goal", "quote": "we first need to make the norms and standards that are currently in place legible and actionable to people while they are editing"},
{"title": "Timely guidance leads to valued changes", "class": "motivation.principle", "quote": "This project is built on the belief that by surfacing relevant guidance in the precious moments when inexperienced volunteers are in the midst of making a change to Wikipedia"},
{"title": "Newcomers more likely in Africa or Asia", "class": "motivation.assessment", "quote": "Newcomers are two times more likely to live in Africa or Asia."},
{"title": "Movement struggles to retain non-Western editors", "class": "motivation.driver", "quote": "The movement struggles to retain editors who live outside Europe and North America."},
{"title": "Sub-Saharan Africa underrepresented among editors", "class": "motivation.assessment", "quote": "people from Sub-Saharan Africa represent only 1% of active unique editors, despite representing 15% of the global population and 7% of the global internet population"},
{"title": "80% of SSA editors use English or French Wikipedia", "class": "motivation.assessment", "quote": "80% of registered editors in Sub-Saharan Africa contribute to English or French Wikipedia."},
{"title": "Minimize false positives in reference detection", "class": "motivation.goal", "quote": "the Editing Team is pursuing an approach with Edit Check that minimizes the likelihood of false positives"},
{"title": "Activate reference check on new unreferenced paragraph in main namespace", "class": "motivation.requirement", "quote": "A minimum of one new paragraph of text is added to the article someone is editing"},
{"title": "Make guidance intuitive so newcomers return", "class": "motivation.goal", "quote": "Increase the likelihood that newcomers and Junior Contributors find the guidance Edit Check is presenting them with, and the editing experience more broadly, to be intuitive and straightforward"},
{"title": "Avoid extra work for experienced volunteers", "class": "motivation.goal", "quote": "Decrease the likelihood that Edit Check is creating more work for experienced volunteers by prompting newcomers and Junior Contributors to add sources when they are not needed"},
{"title": "Moderators must be empowered to configure Edit Check", "class": "motivation.principle", "quote": "The Editing Team thinks it is crucial that moderators be empowered to configure when, and for whom, Edit Check becomes activated."},
{"title": "Audit and edit reference check activation logic", "class": "motivation.requirement", "quote": "**Audit** and **edit** the logic that determines when the reference Edit Check becomes activated"},
{"title": "Review edits of people shown Edit Check", "class": "motivation.requirement", "quote": "**Review** the edits people who are shown Edit Check are making"},
{"title": "Multi-Check increased referenced unreverted edits", "class": "motivation.outcome", "quote": "Multi-Check caused statistically significant increases in the proportion of edits that include a reference and are not reverted within 48 hours without causing undesirable changes in edit completion"},
{"title": "Multiple checks 1.3 times more likely to include reference", "class": "motivation.outcome", "quote": "Edits that were shown multiple Reference Checks in a session are **1.3 times** more likely to include at least one new reference in the final published edit"},
{"title": "Multi-check 34.7% lower revert rate", "class": "motivation.outcome", "quote": "there was a **-34.7% decrease** in revert rate when directly comparing edits presented multiple checks compared to edits presented a single reference check"},
{"title": "5.5% more users publish referenced edits", "class": "motivation.outcome", "quote": "there was a **5.5% increase** in the proportion of distinct users who published a new content edit with a reference when multi-check was available"},
{"title": "No completion decrease up to 5 checks", "class": "motivation.assessment", "quote": "There were **no decreases** in edit completion rate for up to 5 reference checks being presented in a single session"},
{"title": "Multiple checks not disrupting editors", "class": "motivation.assessment", "quote": "indicating that multiple checks are not causing significant disruption or confusion to the editors"},
{"title": "Siderail revert rate decreased 15.7%", "class": "motivation.outcome", "quote": "The revert rate of new content edits where Reference Check was activated decreased by **15.7%**."},
{"title": "Siderail referenced edits increased 8%", "class": "motivation.outcome", "quote": "The proportion of new content edits that included a reference following the change increased **8%**."},
{"title": "Siderail edit completion increased 3.2%", "class": "motivation.outcome", "quote": "Excluding reverted edits, there was **3.2%** increase [2 percentage points] in edit completion rate."},
{"title": "Reference declines decreased 4.7%", "class": "motivation.outcome", "quote": "The rate at which people *declined* to add a reference when Edit Check prompted them decreased **4.7%.**"},
{"title": "Siderail design change net positive", "class": "motivation.assessment", "quote": "The findings above suggest this design change has been net positive."},
{"title": "Reference Check increased edit quality without disruption", "class": "motivation.outcome", "quote": "Reference Check caused an **increase in the quality of edits** newcomers publish and **did not cause any significant disruption**."},
{"title": "Reference Check as default-on is net positive", "class": "motivation.assessment", "quote": "offering Reference Check as a default-on feature would have a net positive impact on all wikis and the people who contribute to them"},
{"title": "2.2 times more likely to publish constructive referenced edit", "class": "motivation.outcome", "quote": "People shown the Reference Check are **2.2 times more likely** to publish a new content edit that includes a reference and is constructive (not reverted within 48 hours)."},
{"title": "Mobile 4.2 times more likely constructive referenced edit", "class": "motivation.outcome", "quote": "contributors are **4.2 times more likely** to publish a constructive new content edit with a reference when Reference Check was shown to eligible edits"},
{"title": "Revert rate decreased 8.6%", "class": "motivation.outcome", "quote": "New content edit revert rate **decreased by 8.6%** if Reference Check was available."},
{"title": "SSA edits 53% less likely reverted", "class": "motivation.outcome", "quote": "New content edits by contributors from Sub-Saharan Africa are **53% less likely** to be reverted when Reference Check is shown to eligible edits."},
{"title": "16% higher constructive retention", "class": "motivation.outcome", "quote": "Contributors that are shown Reference Check and successfully save a non-reverted edit are **16 percent more likely** to return to make a non-reverted edit in their second month"},
{"title": "10% edit completion decrease with Reference Check", "class": "motivation.assessment", "quote": "Overall, there was a **10% decrease** in edit completion rate for edits where Reference Check was shown."},
{"title": "No increase in block rate", "class": "motivation.assessment", "quote": "There were **decreases or no changes** in the rate of users blocked after after being shown Reference Check and publishing an edit"},
{"title": "Low false negative rate 1.8%", "class": "motivation.assessment", "quote": "There was a low false negative rate. Only **1.8%** of all published new content edits in the test group did not include a new reference and were not shown Reference Check."},
{"title": "False positive rate 6.6%", "class": "motivation.assessment", "quote": "**6.6%** of contributors dismissed adding a citation because they indicated the new content being added does not need a reference."},
{"title": "Increase quality of SSA newcomer edits", "class": "motivation.outcome", "quote": "Increase the quality of edits newcomers and Junior Contributors editing from within Sub-Saharan Africa publish in the main namespace"},
{"title": "Increase likelihood SSA newcomers add references", "class": "motivation.outcome", "quote": "Increase the likelihood that newcomers and Junior Contributors editing from within Sub-Saharan Africa will accompany the new content they are adding with a reference"},
{"title": "SSA newcomers report feeling safe and confident", "class": "motivation.outcome", "quote": "Newcomers and Junior Contributors editing from within Sub-Saharan Africa will report feeling safe and confident making changes to Wikipedia"},
{"title": "Experienced volunteers audit Edit Check configurations", "class": "motivation.outcome", "quote": "Experienced volunteers will independently audit and iterate upon Edit Check's default configurations to ensure Edit Check is causing newcomers and Junior Contributors to make productive edits."},
{"title": "Newcomers more aware of need for references", "class": "motivation.outcome", "quote": "Newcomers and Junior Contributors will be more aware of the need to add a reference when contributing new content because the visual editor will prompt them to do so"},
{"title": "Risk: edit quality decreases", "class": "motivation.assessment", "quote": "Edit quality decreases"},
{"title": "Risk: unreliable citations harder to patrol", "class": "motivation.assessment", "quote": "Edits become more difficult to patrol because unreliable citations are difficult to detect"},
{"title": "Risk: edit completion rate drastically decreases", "class": "motivation.assessment", "quote": "Edit completion rate drastically decreases"},
{"title": "Risk: edit abandonment rate drastically increases", "class": "motivation.assessment", "quote": "Edit abandonment rate drastically increases"},
{"title": "Risk: blocks increase", "class": "motivation.assessment", "quote": "Blocks increase"},
{"title": "Risk: high false positive or negative rates", "class": "motivation.assessment", "quote": "High false positive or false negative rates"},
{"title": "Risk: Edit Check too resource intensive to scale", "class": "motivation.assessment", "quote": "Edit Check is too resource intensive to scale"}
]}
